Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You introduce yourself, offer a little news from the road, and ask who has room beside the fire. As people answer, you watch for a face willing to welcome you.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
A short conversation, outside combat.
Target / range / shape
A nonhostile gathering that can understand you; a short conversation
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

No forced friendship or compelled service. If ordinary hospitality is freely offered, take it without a roll. DA names the objective before a consequential attempt.

Weak
Make 1 progress toward acceptance.
Standard
Make 2 progress and learn a useful local custom.
Strong
Make 3 progress and gain an introduction to a willing local contact.
